data.notes: November 2026 in Goa is led by early-season electronic and afro-house club programming, psytrance-adjacent open-air parties, and large lifestyle festivals with substantial music stages.

events.title: Royal Enfield Motoverse 2026
events.summary: Motoverse returns to HillTop, Vagator with live music as a major part of the three-day motorcycle-culture festival. First announced performers include Farhan Akhtar, Lifafa, Reble, Sanjith Hegde, MHR & Friends, The Think Floydian, Rushil, Mali, Suggahunny, Curtain Blue, Komorebi & Goya, OG SHEZ and Aksomaniac.

events.title: Afro Indi Music Festival
events.summary: Afro-house focused festival at Masaya headlined by Oskido, with Ashiva, BLOT, Darque, Diatonik, Houdini and Robotic also listed. The event is billed as an Africa-meets-India dance-floor concept in Goa.

events.title: OCHOK at Raeeth Goa
events.summary: Tour date from Paris-born, Hollywood-based DJ/producer OCHOK, noted for Afro House and indie-house sounds, landing at Raeeth Goa during his November India run.

events.title: Yara Live: Open-Air
events.summary: A verified open-air psytrance event marking Yara’s India tour and 20-year milestone, with Karran Khanna and Gabba also announced. The listing runs 9:00 pm to 9:00 am at Ocean Pirates Cafe.

events.title: India Debut 2026 ft. Nebut Drums
events.summary: India debut for international live percussion act Nebut/Nebat Drums at Tikitii, framed as a high-energy rhythm-led electronic and house-adjacent performance with global percussion and dance-floor focus.

events.title: Bassline Travellers 67.0 Night To Sunrise
events.summary: Recurring Goa sunrise session at House of Chapora built around hypnotic techno and trance, running 10 PM to 7 AM with LED show and night-to-sunrise format.

events.title: DJ Chetas Live at UNVRS Goa
events.summary: DJ Chetas is listed for UNVRS Club Vagator on 14 November at 10:00 pm. BookMyShow bills the run as a Bollywood-commercial mashups and party-hits club experience.

events.title: Moon Festival 2026
events.summary: A three-day South Goa gathering combining wellness, dance, movement, music, art and community. The ticket page lists 20+ musicians and includes performances, gigs and bands across the festival pass.

events.title: Goa Daddy Festival – Edition 2
events.summary: A queer community festival in Baga with an all-inclusive resort format, a Signature Blackout Party with professional DJs and premium sound, a Splash Pool Party with high-energy DJ music, live music night, karaoke, and the Roots & Pride final-night celebration.
